categories.title: Strengths
categories.hint: What the student already brings to their learning.

academic-ability.label: Academic Ability
academic-ability.description: Demonstrates strong ability and produces high-quality work.

creative-thinking.label: Creative Thinking
creative-thinking.description: Brings creativity, curiosity and original ideas to learning.

independent-learning.label: Independent Learning
independent-learning.description: Works confidently and independently on familiar tasks.

positive-contribution.label: Positive Contribution
positive-contribution.description: Brings enthusiasm, energy and ideas to the classroom.

inconsistent-focus.label: Inconsistent Focus
inconsistent-focus.description: Difficulty maintaining focus can limit demonstrated achievement.

uneven-performance.label: Uneven Performance
uneven-performance.description: Inconsistent engagement can prevent strengths from being fully demonstrated.

task-confidence.label: Task Confidence
task-confidence.description: Can be hesitant to attempt unfamiliar or challenging tasks.

rushed-work.label: Rushed Work
rushed-work.description: Rushing tasks can affect accuracy and quality.

consistent-application.label: Consistent Application
consistent-application.description: Applying strengths more consistently will be an important next step.

extend-abilities.label: Extend Abilities
extend-abilities.description: Building confidence with unfamiliar tasks will help extend abilities.

work-quality.label: Work Quality
work-quality.description: Taking greater care to review and refine work will be a priority.

greater-independence.label: Greater Independence
greater-independence.description: Developing independence with challenging tasks will support further growth.

categories.title: Engagement in Learning
categories.hint: How the student takes part in learning.

positive-engagement.label: Positive Engagement
positive-engagement.description: Participates willingly and contributes positively to learning.

responds-to-support.label: Responds to Support
responds-to-support.description: Responds well to encouragement and individual guidance.

growing-independence.label: Growing Independence
growing-independence.description: Shows increasing independence in following instructions and completing tasks.

interest-based.label: Interest Based
interest-based.description: Engages enthusiastically in practical, creative and preferred activities.

task-initiation.label: Task Initiation
task-initiation.description: Often needs encouragement to begin learning tasks.

maintaining-focus.label: Maintaining Focus
maintaining-focus.description: Distractions can affect sustained engagement and task completion.

task-resistance.label: Task Resistance
task-resistance.description: Sometimes resists instructions or unfamiliar learning activities.

limited-perseverance.label: Limited Perseverance
limited-perseverance.description: Can struggle to persist when tasks become challenging.

independent-start.label: Independent Start
independent-start.description: Beginning tasks with less prompting will be an important next step.

building-perseverance.label: Building Perseverance
building-perseverance.description: Developing persistence with challenging tasks will be a priority.

learning-routines.label: Learning Routines
learning-routines.description: Establishing consistent routines will support focus and task completion.

broader-participation.label: Broader Participation
broader-participation.description: Engaging more consistently across subjects will be a key focus.

positive-relationships.label: Positive Relationships
positive-relationships.description: Relates well to peers and staff, showing kindness and respect.

classroom-contribution.label: Classroom Contribution
classroom-contribution.description: Brings humour, enthusiasm and positive energy to the classroom.

communication-confidence.label: Communication Confidence
communication-confidence.description: Shows growing confidence in expressing ideas and joining discussions.

emotional-awareness.label: Emotional Awareness
emotional-awareness.description: Demonstrates increasing awareness of emotions and responses to challenges.

managing-emotions.label: Managing Emotions
managing-emotions.description: Can find it difficult to manage frustration or disappointment.

communication-confidence-challenge.label: Communication Confidence
communication-confidence-challenge.description: Sometimes struggles to express needs or seek assistance.

peer-distractions.label: Peer Distractions
peer-distractions.description: Social interactions can sometimes disrupt learning and focus.

adapting-to-change.label: Adapting to Change
adapting-to-change.description: Can find changes to routines or expectations challenging.

emotional-regulation.label: Emotional Regulation
emotional-regulation.description: Strengthening emotional regulation and resilience will be a key priority.

respectful-communication.label: Respectful Communication
respectful-communication.description: Developing listening and communication skills will support positive interactions.

social-confidence.label: Social Confidence
social-confidence.description: Building confidence in relationships and group activities will be an important focus.

positive-choices.label: Positive Choices
positive-choices.description: Recognising emotions and making constructive choices will be a valuable next step.

categories.title: Attendance
categories.hint: Factual context. State only what was selected.

consistent-attendance.label: Consistent Attendance
consistent-attendance.description: Has maintained consistent attendance throughout the semester.

improved-attendance.label: Improved Attendance
improved-attendance.description: Has shown improved attendance and stronger classroom routines.

regular-participation.label: Regular Participation
regular-participation.description: Attends regularly and participates in classroom learning.

positive-commitment.label: Positive Commitment
positive-commitment.description: Demonstrates commitment to attending and engaging in school.

irregular-attendance.label: Irregular Attendance
irregular-attendance.description: Irregular attendance has affected continuity of learning.

limited-attendance.label: Limited Attendance
limited-attendance.description: Limited attendance has restricted opportunities to observe progress.

extended-absences.label: Extended Absences
extended-absences.description: Extended absences have affected routines and classroom connections.

inconsistent-participation.label: Inconsistent Participation
inconsistent-participation.description: Inconsistent attendance has limited access to learning and support.

attendance-consistency.label: Attendance Consistency
attendance-consistency.description: Establishing consistent attendance will be a key priority next term.

regular-participation-development.label: Regular Participation
regular-participation-development.description: Increasing attendance will support learning continuity and progress.

sustainable-routines.label: Sustainable Routines
sustainable-routines.description: Developing a sustainable attendance routine will support engagement.

school-connections.label: School Connections
school-connections.description: Attending more consistently will help strengthen classroom connections.

categories.title: Development Areas / Focus for Next Term

growing-confidence.label: Growing Confidence
growing-confidence.description: Has made encouraging progress in confidence and independence.

positive-response.label: Positive Response
positive-response.description: Increasingly responds well to guidance and encouragement.

demonstrated-growth.label: Demonstrated Growth
demonstrated-growth.description: Has shown meaningful improvement in developing skills and abilities.

improving-consistency.label: Improving Consistency
improving-consistency.description: Is showing greater consistency in applying learning strategies.

task-completion.label: Task Completion
task-completion.description: Difficulty maintaining focus can affect task completion.

learning-confidence.label: Learning Confidence
learning-confidence.description: Confidence and perseverance remain areas requiring support.

inconsistent-engagement.label: Inconsistent Engagement
inconsistent-engagement.description: Inconsistent participation has limited sustained learning progress.

developing-independence.label: Developing Independence
developing-independence.description: Continues to need support with routines and independent learning.

independent-learning-development.label: Independent Learning
independent-learning-development.description: Strengthening independence and task completion will be a key priority.

confidence-building.label: Confidence Building
confidence-building.description: Developing confidence and perseverance will support future learning.

classroom-routines.label: Classroom Routines
classroom-routines.description: Establishing consistent routines will be an important next step.

continued-growth.label: Continued Growth
continued-growth.description: Building on existing strengths will support further personal and academic growth.

categories.title: Specific Adjustments / Supports
categories.hint: Adjustments already in place. Selected items, and anything typed below, are named in one sentence.

learning-support.label: Learning support
learning-support.description: Extra help with the learning is already part of lessons.

adjusted-tasks.label: Adjusted tasks
adjusted-tasks.description: Tasks are adjusted so the student can show what they know.

extra-time.label: Extra time
extra-time.description: More time is given to begin, work and finish.

assistive-technology.label: Assistive technology
assistive-technology.description: A tool or device is used so the student can take part in the learning.

visual-supports.label: Visual supports
visual-supports.description: A visual shows the steps or what the finished learning looks like.

structured-routines.label: Structured routines
structured-routines.description: A clear routine sets out what happens and in which order.

sensory-supports.label: Sensory supports
sensory-supports.description: The setting or materials are adjusted for sensory comfort.

wellbeing-support.label: Wellbeing support
wellbeing-support.description: Support for wellbeing is part of the regular routine.

family-communication.label: Family communication
family-communication.description: Family or carers and staff share updates about learning and support.

flexible-learning.label: Flexible learning
flexible-learning.description: Where, when or how learning happens is adjusted so the student can take part.

movement-breaks.label: Movement breaks
movement-breaks.description: Planned pauses for movement are part of the routine.

one-on-one-support.label: 1 on 1 Support
one-on-one-support.description: One-to-one support with the learning is already part of lessons.

clear-expectations.label: Clear Expectations
clear-expectations.description: What is expected is stated clearly before the learning begins.

group-work.label: Group Work
group-work.description: Some of the learning happens by working with others.

noise-reduction.label: Noise Reduction
noise-reduction.description: Noise is reduced so the student can take part in the learning.

quiet-learning-environment.label: Quiet Learning Environment
quiet-learning-environment.description: A quiet setting is used for the learning.
